Free reading clubs and tutoring for children who find reading hard

Harbourside Literacy Trust runs after-school reading clubs and pairs trained volunteers with children aged six to eleven for weekly one-to-one sessions in twelve Bristol primary schools.

Donate See the programs

Programs

  • After-school reading clubs — small groups, twice a week, in the school library.
  • One-to-one tutoring — a trained volunteer and the same child every week for a school year.
  • Summer reading challenge — six weeks of books, badges and a party in September.

Last year in numbers

140 volunteers read with 612 children. Nine in ten children who completed a year of tutoring moved up at least one reading band.

What teachers say

“The club is the one thing our reluctant readers ask for by name.”

— Year 4 teacher, Bedminster
